title: Subtracting 52 From 80 Column by Column
description: Borrowing across a zero when the top digit is smaller than the bottom digit.
narration_lines: Line up the two numbers by their columns.
The top digit, 0, is smaller than 2, so borrow from the 8: it becomes 7, and the 0 becomes 10. 10 minus 2 is 8. Then 7 minus 5 is 2.

params.footnote: borrow from the left when the top digit is too small
